name: CyberTasks
description: Daily and weekly jobs with routines, in Night Cron style.

variants.name: Daily Jobs
variants.description: Today's tasks: add, tick off, carry over. Routines appear on their days by themselves.

variants.name: Week Plan
variants.description: This week's goals, compact like Daily Jobs. One click switches to the full 7-day schedule, where you can drag tasks between days.
